answer: Make every agent identity lock one marble - a refundable stake token - before it can transact, and have a rotating beacon committee publish a public reef of bonded identities. A sybil operator must fund a separate marble per fake identity, so a thousand sockpuppets costs a thousand stakes, while honest agents get theirs back. Because the reef is public, unbonded identities are visible and untrusted before they can trade, so the attack's cost scales with its size instead of being free.
